title: Application
description: Monolith traffic, errors, latency, JVM and error logs.

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: All API requests, the Prometheus scrape of /metrics excluded.

panels.title: 5xx errors
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 5xx status: a bug or an unavailable dependency.

panels.title: 4xx errors
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 4xx status. Domain errors (422), missing or forbidden resources (404) and expired tokens (401) land here; a sudden jump usually means a broken client release.

panels.title: p95 response
panels.description: 95% of requests were answered faster than this.

panels.title: Instances
panels.description: Monolith processes Prometheus can scrape. Two during a deploy, while the new one starts next to the old one.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the newest monolith process started, which is the last deploy or restart.

panels.title: Requests by status
panels.description: Requests per second, split by HTTP status.

panels.title: Response time
panels.description: Average and 95th percentile over all requests, and the slowest single request of the last ~2 minutes (Micrometer's decaying max). The p95 is interpolated within histogram buckets (5ms … 10s).

panels.title: Routes
panels.description: Every route called in the selected time range. Route n/a is a path that matched no route (a 404).

targets.expr: sum by (method, route) (increase(ktor_http_server_requests_seconds_sum{job="monolith", route!="/metrics"}[$__range])) / sum by (method, route) (increase(ktor_http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="monolith", route!="/metrics"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (method, route, le) (increase(ktor_http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job="monolith", route!="/metrics"}[$__range])))

(sum by (method, route) (increase(ktor_http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="monolith", route!="/metrics", status=~"4.."}[$__range])) or sum by (method, route) (increase(ktor_http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="monolith", route!="/metrics"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (method, route) (increase(ktor_http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="monolith", route!="/metrics"}[$__range]))

(sum by (method, route) (increase(ktor_http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="monolith", route!="/metrics", status=~"5.."}[$__range])) or sum by (method, route) (increase(ktor_http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="monolith", route!="/metrics"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (method, route) (increase(ktor_http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="monolith", route!="/metrics"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: The container's memory against its limit (an OOM kill restarts it), and the JVM heap inside it.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU used by the monolith process, as a share of all the node's CPUs.

panels.title: Garbage collection
panels.description: Seconds per second spent in GC pauses, and the longest single pause. A rising GC share with a full heap means the heap is too small.

panels.title: Threads and in-flight requests
panels.description: JVM threads, and requests being handled right now (the scrape itself counts as one).

panels.title: MariaDB
panels.description: Whether the database exporter can reach monolith.database.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Open connections against max_connections. The monolith holds 5 x APPLICATION_DB_POOL_SIZE, twice that during a deploy.

panels.title: Buffer hits
panels.description: InnoDB page reads served from the buffer pool instead of disk (100% while the database is idle). Below ~99% the 2G pool is too small for the working set.

panels.title: Valkey
panels.description: Whether the Valkey exporter can reach monolith.redis.

panels.title: Valkey memory
panels.description: Memory against --maxmemory. Valkey runs with noeviction: when full it rejects writes, which fails every idempotent request and event delivery.

panels.title: Valkey keys
panels.description: Idempotency responses, event markers and claims currently stored.

panels.title: MariaDB queries
panels.description: Statements per second, and statements slower than long_query_time.

panels.title: MariaDB locks
panels.description: Row lock waits per second, and deadlocks (retried by the transaction manager, a 409 when retries run out).

panels.title: Valkey
panels.description: Commands per second and open client connections.

panels.title: Log lines by level
panels.description: How many lines the monolith logged, by level.

panels.title: Warnings and errors
panels.description: The monolith's WARN and ERROR lines, newest first, stack traces included. Open the Logs dashboard for everything else.
